title: ranunculus carinatus
intro: Ranunculus carinatus, commonly known as the Rough-seeded Buttercup, is a plant species that belongs to the Ranunculaceae family. This plant is known for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Ranunculus carinatus include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial agent, making it effective in treating wounds, burns, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Ranunculus carinatus include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
